DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Retinitis

The fundoscopy findings of granular yellow-white opacities and hemorrhages, combined with your AIDS history and lack of pain, are classic for CMV retinitis. Given your recent treatment for fungal esophagitis and history of Kaposi's sarcoma, your immune system is severely compromised, making this an urgent sight-threatening infection. We need to start antiviral therapy immediately to prevent permanent blindness.
